note: Floor and ceiling anchors for the anchor scale s = (accuracy - floor) / (ceiling - floor). Floors are computed exactly from the task file (baselines.py). Ceilings are reported values from papers; see 'source' and 'status'.

ceiling.name: human experts (LAB-Bench paper)
ceiling.source: LAB-Bench, arXiv 2407.10362v3, Appendix B, Table 2 (accuracy, column Human), per subtask
ceiling.status: reported; values read by a model-run extraction of the arXiv HTML on 2026-11-21, not yet checked by a person against the table. Their mean (0.789) matches the 78.8% that the Biomni paper cites for SeqQA humans.
ceiling.caveat: Humans could answer 'unsure' (coverage below 1 in some subtasks), and the human set was the paper's 750 questions, not only the 600 public rows.
